Jules: Heads-up I opened a small PR to standardize streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4450

docs-bot: PR 4450 opened by Jules — title: 'docs: standardize streaming examples + pagination migration notes'

Rina: Quick review: TS still uses callbacks; please switch to async iterator (`for await`) so it matches our SDK patterns.

Ben: Also the Python example swallows exceptions. Let's show a minimal backoff helper (exponential + jitter) and keep snippets <= 10 lines.

Jules: Agreed. Plan: 1) Py -> async generator + with_backoff helper 2) TS -> for-await 3) Go -> channel + context 4) add one-line pagination migration showing `next_cursor` in body 5) fix old streaming link on overview page

Rina: TS suggestion:
```ts
const stream = client.asyncGenerate({prompt:'hi'})
for await (const c of stream) console.log(c.text)
```

Ben: Py backoff helper (compact):
```python
async def with_backoff(gen, *a, **kw):
  for i in range(3):
    try:
      async for x in gen(*a, **kw): yield x; return
    except TransientError:
      await asyncio.sleep(min(0.5*2**i, 5)+random.random())
```

Jules: Go snippet: one-liner channel pattern preferred. Also add migration note: `cursor = resp.get('next_cursor')` (py) / `resp.nextCursor` (go) / `resp.next_cursor` (ts).

Rina: Pushed TS and overview link fix. CI preview looks fine.

Ben: Pushed Python + small test changes. Left a comment about naming `TransientError` in examples.

Jules: Verified preview, merging after @docs approves. Thanks :thumbsup:
